jobs.title: Customer Retention Manager
jobs.description: About Upsun (formerly Platform.sh) Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today’s hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale confidently without wrestling with backend infrastructure. We give you your time back. You get: Predictable performance, even at scale Secure, compliant environments by default Real-time observability and profiling built in Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds AI-ready features that plug directly into your stack The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation. Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum. What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work. Our values: We make a positive impact. ✨ We aim for the stars. We care for each other. Impact of a Customer Retention Manager As our Customer Retention Manager, you play a key role in protecting and growing revenue across a high-volume portfolio of customer accounts. Your day-to-day is proactive, human outreach and health monitoring — building real relationships at scale, bringing a human touch to segments that are often managed purely through automation, and catching risk early. When you manage that well, renewal conversations become a natural next step rather than the main event. You'll also work within the workflows, health scoring, automation, and segmentation that let retention scale without creating internal chaos, all while keeping the renewal experience smart, timely, and low-friction. Reporting to our VP, Customer Success, this role is ideal for someone who loves building, improving processes, testing ideas, and seeing direct impact on both customer outcomes and business performance. You'll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Data, and GTM teams to inform retention strategy and engagement models across the business. What to expect Renewal Ownership & Pipeline Management: Manage a rolling pipeline of customer renewals across a high-volume portfolio, initiating conversations ahead of contract expiration and driving each account through to close. Retention Workflow Support: Help build and improve scalable retention and renewal workflows using Salesforce and integrated tooling, contributing to repeatable processes that hold up as portfolio volume grows. Proactive Relationship Building: Own direct, human outreach to smaller and long-tail accounts by proactively building relationships with them. Lifecycle & Tech-Touch Design: Contribute to the design of customer lifecycle journeys, engagement triggers, and tech-touch motions Health Scoring & Risk Identification: Use customer health scoring frameworks- built on usage, engagement, and lifecycle signals- to identify at-risk accounts early, partnering with internal stakeholders to develop and execute save strategies. Automation & AI Enablement: Support the implementation of automated outreach, lifecycle campaigns, and renewal risk workflows, and flag opportunities to leverage AI and automation. Commercial Negotiation: Negotiate pricing, contract terms, and multi-year agreements within established company guidelines. Expansion Identification: Partner with Customer Success Managers and Account Executives to identify and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities during the renewal cycle. Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Data, and GTM teams to support and inform retention strategy and customer engagement models. What you bring Renewal Lifecycle Experience: Experience managing a rolling renewal pipeline, engaging customers well in advance of contract expiration. Commercial Negotiation Skills: Experience negotiating pricing, contract terms, and multi-year agreements within established guidelines. Risk Identification & Save Strategy: Ability to identify at-risk accounts early and collaborate cross-functionally on save strategies. CRM & Systems Experience: Hands-on experience working within Salesforce or a similar CRM, including contributing to operational workflows or lifecycle processes. Retention & Lifecycle Knowledge: Solid understanding of customer health scoring, lifecycle automation, and retention strategy. Expansion Mindset: Proven ability to identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities in partnership with CSMs and Account Executives. Versatility: Comfort operating across both customer-facing engagement conversations and systems/process design conversations. Growth Mindset: Demonstrates a sustained commitment to continuous improvement, actively seeking out better ways to engage customers and support scalable operations. Where we hire At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend - it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in the UK, France, Spain, Germany or Canada . Although we’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries. How we hire We know that a great hire won’t meet every requirement that we’ve outlined. If you can see yourself elevating the team, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here had we not taken a chance. You can expect 4 video interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. Should you successfully move through the entire process you will have the opportunity to meet with a variety of Upsunners. Our goal is to ensure you can make the most informed decision on whether this role, and our culture aligns with what you’re looking for in your future working environment. 45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition 60 Minutes with Hiring

jobs.title: Detection Engineering & Response Lead
jobs.description: About Nebius: Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI. Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D. The Role We're hiring a Detection Engineering & Response Lead to build and run our D&R capability from the ground up. You'll own the detection engineering, threat intelligence, and incident response functions across Nebius Cloud - and lead a small, growing team of analysts and engineers. This is a lead engineering role responsible for detection development, handling the most complex security incidents, forensics, and shaping the D&R strategy. What you’ll do Lead detection development: achieve full MITRE coverage, maintain low false-positive and false-negative rates. Work closely with alerts consumers (20+ teams) to keep noise low and signal high, ensuring they can act quickly without missing genuine threats. Architect and operate detection coverage across our cloud and bare-metal environments Build and extend our internal D&R tools and pipelines - onboard new logs, build and automate response runbooks. Integrate threat intelligence into detection logic and IR playbooks, tracking adversary TTPs relevant to Cloud infrastructure Lead incident response end-to-end: scoping, containment, root cause analysis, post-incident reviews and controlling critical action items are closed to prevent future possible incidents. Partner with Compliance and Engineering teams to detect real threats while meeting the needs of both engineers and regulators. Define and report on D&R metrics: MTTD, MTTR, detection coverage, false positive rates, etc. Build and maintain Security Incident Response program: people, processes, tools. Build tools, runbooks, and on-call processes that scale as the company grows. What we look for 6+ years in security operations, detection engineering, or incident response — with at least 1–2 years leading or mentoring a team. Deep hands-on experience with cloud-native environments (Kubernetes, Linux workloads, container-based infrastructure). Strong detection engineering skills: writing and tuning rules/detections in SIEM platforms (e.g., Chronicle, Splunk, Elastic) and SQL. Experience building or operating SOAR workflows and automating response at scale (ideally with Golang and Temporal). Working knowledge of threat intelligence frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK, Pyramid of Pain, Kill Chain) and how to operationalize them in detections. Solid IR fundamentals: memory forensics, log analysis, network traffic analysis, and post-incident reporting. Stakeholder management: able to coordinate across engineers, compliance, legal, executives during active incident phase. Serve as the primary owner and driver for complex changes, as a result of incidents post-mortem. Nice to have: Experience with AI/ML and GPU clusters related threats. Familiarity with eBPF-based detection or runtime security tooling (Falco, Tetragon). Background in threat hunting. Why this role at Nebius Build D&R at a company scaling from startup to global infrastructure provider in real time. Ability to evolve our internal D&R platform into a new cloud security product, delivering novel security observability for a range of neocloud customers - from big tech to AI startups. Work alongside world-class engineers on infrastructure that powers frontier AI. Competitive compensation with equity upside in a Nasdaq-listed, high-growth company. Flexible, remote-first culture. Benefits & Perks: Competitive compensation Career growth and learning opportunities Flexibility and ownership Collaborative and innovative culture Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects International environment and talented teams What's it like to work at Nebius: Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI Equal Opportunity Statement: Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire. If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: The company and our mission: Zartis is a global AI transformation and technology consulting partner where talented engineers and technologists work on cutting edge innovation. We partner with ambitious organizations to design, build, and scale technology solutions that deliver real impact. Our teams bring deep expertise in AI driven platforms, secure API architectures, and cloud native engineering. You will work on meaningful projects that accelerate the adoption of advanced technologies, from strategy and discovery through to full product delivery, helping turn complex challenges into measurable outcomes. With engineering hubs across EMEA and LATAM, and long term partnerships in financial services, healthcare and life sciences, and energy and climate, we offer opportunities to work on projects that truly matter. Here, you will not just build technology, you will drive business impact and grow your career alongside industry leaders. We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to work on a project in the industrial engineering services industry. The project: We are talented people that come from a variety of backgrounds. We’re committed to building an inclusive culture based on trust and innovation. You will be part of a distributed team developing new technologies to solve real business problems. We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our client small data team, working alongside one existing Power Platform/data engineer as a peer. The role combines Power Platform development (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI) with hands-on data engineering using Python, SQL, Azure Data Factory, and Microsoft Fabric. The immediate priority is data ingestion: helping migrate and ingest data from a variety of sources into a Fabric medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold). Once this priority workload is established, focus will shift to broader work including CI/CD pipeline hardening, development standards, and best practice across the team's Power Platform and Fabric estate. This is a hands-on technical role, where you'll be working day-to-day alongside the existing engineer, sharing knowledge, and contributing equally to delivery. What you will do: Design, build, and maintain pipelines to ingest and migrate data from a variety of sources (on-prem databases, APIs, flat files, line-of-business systems) into Microsoft Fabric. Implement and maintain Fabric medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold layers), structuring transformation logic for data quality and consistency. Write Python (e.g. PySpark, notebooks) and SQL for data transformation, cleansing, and modelling within Fabric Lakehouses and Warehouses. Build and orchestrate pipelines using Azure Data Factory and/or Fabric Data Factory. Develop and maintain Power Apps (canvas and model-driven) for operational engineering use cases. Build Power Automate flows that integrate with Azure services and Fabric data Develop Power BI reports and dashboards consuming curated Fabric (Gold layer) data. Maintain and extend Dataverse tables, relationships, and security Models. Contribute to hardening CI/CD pipelines for both Power Platform solutions and Fabric/data engineering code, using Azure DevOps. Help establish and document development standards, naming conventions, and code review practices. Support governance activities including environment strategy, DLP policies, and Fabric workspace/capacity management. Liaise with engineering stakeholders to understand requirements for data, automation, and reporting needs. Provide ongoing support and troubleshooting for existing pipelines, flows, and apps. What you will bring: Hands-on development experience across Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI. Strong working proficiency in Python and SQL for data transformation and pipeline development. Practical experience with Microsoft Fabric, including medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), Lakehouses, and Dataflows Gen2. Experience with Azure Data Factory (or Fabric Data Factory) for orchestrating data ingestion and transformation pipelines. Experience migrating or ingesting data from diverse sources (databases, APIs, files, legacy systems) into a modern data platform. Solid understanding of Dataverse, including table design, security roles, and relationships. Experience working in an engineering, manufacturing, or industrial sector. Comfortable working collaboratively as part of a small team, sharing knowledge and reviewing peers' work. Familiarity with Azure DevOps for source control and release management. Nice to have: Microsoft certifications (e.g. PL-400, PL-300, DP-600 or DP-700). Experience with PySpark notebooks in Microsoft Fabric. Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines for Power Platform and data engineering solutions. Exposure to Copilot Studio or AI Builder. Experience working with engineering, manufacturing or industrial data. Understanding of IoT or sensor data integration. What we offer: 100% Remote Work WFH allowance: Monthly payment as financial support for remote working. Career Growth: We have established a career development program accessible for all employees with a 360º feedback that will help us to guide you in your career progression. Training: For Tech training at Zartis, you have time allocated during the week at your disposal. You can request from a variety of options, such as online courses (from Pluralsight and Educative.io, for example), English classes, books, conferences, and events. Mentoring Program: You can become a mentor in Zartis or you can receive mentorship, or both. Zartis Wellbeing Hub (Kara Connect) : A platform that provides sessions with a range of specialists, including mental health professionals, nutritionists, physiotherapists, fitness coaches, and webinars with such professionals as well. Multicultural working environment: We organize tech events, webinars, parties, and activities to do online team-building games and contests.

jobs.description: Are you a talented Senior Designer looking for a remote job that lets you show your skills and get decent compensation? jobs.description: ## About Outsite Outsite is a global coliving company for remote workers — hotel-quality service, extended-stay flexibility, and a built-in community, at the intersection of hospitality and lifestyle. We operate 40+ properties across 21+ cities on 5 continents, with 6,000+ verified members and an NPS of 65. ## About Outsite for Teams Outsite for Teams is Outsite's B2B expansion — giving companies, teams, and communities access to our global network of coliving and coworking spaces for their employees. Rather than a bulk discount, we position it as a meaningful perk: founders and leaders purchase memberships on behalf of their team, and a dedicated account manager keeps them active and engaged. This is a genuine growth priority for the business, and you'll be one of the first dedicated sales hires driving it. ## Role Overview We're hiring a Business Development Representative to build and run outbound sales for Outsite for Teams. You'll identify and prospect the right companies, run discovery calls, and close new business — turning remote-first startups, distributed teams, and growth-stage companies into long-term Outsite for Teams accounts. This is a highly autonomous, build-it-yourself role. You'll help shape the outbound playbook, not just execute someone else's. ## Key Responsibilities ### 1. Prospecting & Outbound - Build and work target lists of remote-first and hybrid companies, using signals like team size (50–500), remote/hybrid language in company descriptions, and titles such as Head of People, Chief of Staff, VP of Operations, or Founder - Source leads via LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Wellfound/AngelList, Crunchbase, remote job boards (We Work Remotely, Remote.co), and Outsite's own member base - Run cold outbound via email, LinkedIn, and calls, and continuously test and refine messaging - Reach out to local companies near Outsite locations to sell business travel and corporate stay packages - Build partnerships with travel agencies and tour operators to generate referral and bundled-stay opportunities ### 2. Sales & Pipeline Management - Run discovery calls to understand a prospect's team, travel patterns, and remote work culture - Own the full sales cycle from first touch to close - Keep the CRM clean and current — every deal staged, every next step logged - Forecast pipeline accurately and hit monthly/quarterly new business targets ### 3. Collaboration & Handoff - Partner with the Head of Marketing on positioning, collateral, and campaigns that support outbound - Hand off closed accounts cleanly to the account management side, with full context on the client's goals - Share market feedback — what's resonating, what isn't — to sharpen Outsite for Teams' pitch and ICP over time ### 4. Reporting - Report weekly on pipeline: volume, stage, conversion, and blockers - Track and share what's working in outbound so it can be systematized ## Required Skills & Experience - 1+ years of B2B sales or business development experience (SDR/BDR background a plus) - Confident, consultative communicator — comfortable running discovery calls with founders and People leaders - Self-starter who's built pipeline from scratch, not just worked warm leads - Able to work autonomously and independently - Comfortable with taking initiative and being proactive - Comfortable working European timezone hours - Strong written communication — outbound copy is part of the job - Organized; keeps a CRM honest without being told to - Comfortable using AI in workflow ## Nice to Have - Experience selling to remote-first or distributed teams - Familiarity with Pipedrive or HubSpot - Existing network in the startup, remote work, or travel/hospitality space - Experience selling a membership, subscription, or perk-style product ## What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days) - A working, documented outbound playbook (lists, messaging, cadence) - A full and accurately-staged pipeline in the CRM - First qualified meetings booked and first deals in late-stage or closed - Clear, weekly reporting rhythm established with Marketing - Sharpened point of view on which ICPs convert fastest ## Benefits - Remote, travel encouraged - Credits for Outsite locations - Salary - $45,000 - $50,000 USD + commission

jobs.title: Senior Independent Software Developer
jobs.description: You must be located in the Americas, Europe, or Israel to apply. A·Team is a VC-backed, stealth, application-only home on the internet for senior independent software builders to team up with hand-picked, high-growth companies on their next big thing. After talking with hundreds of independent engineers, designers, and product folks, we heard over and over that finding vetted, high-quality, consistent clients is hard, and projects are often too small to be rewarding. A·Team matches small teams of the most talented builders in the world with companies backed by a16z, YC, Softbank, General Catalyst, etc. on a contract basis for many of their most important initiatives. We quietly launched in May 2020, and have helped A·Teamers earn $85+ million since. As part of A·Team, you can expect: High-paying, meaningful missions with the most audacious companies sent your way; generally $90-$150+/hr, with vetted, fascinating clients doing work that matters. We're picky about who we partner with; new clients only come in via trusted referral. We've worked with Lyft, McGraw Hill, ClearCo, Pepsi, Walmart, the former CEO of Waze, the leading vaccine production software, several new unicorns we can't say here, and dozens of startups backed by a16z/YC/Softbank/Insight/Tiger/etc. Work alongside friends old & new: our niche is small/diverse product teams, since clients with larger budgets and higher-impact work tell us they want teams, not individuals. Of course, we keep friends together whenever we can. Full autonomy: say "no" to things that don't excite you. The most talented builders often juggle a few things at once, so there's never pressure to join an A·Team mission if you don't have the bandwidth. If we're no longer a fit, it's easy to leave or pause too. Small, curated, off-the-record gatherings: for conversations hard to have elsewhere. Long-term, we're creating micro-communities for the world's top builders to become friends around the things they care about. Keep 100% of what you earn: if you charge $120/hr, you get $120/hr. A·Team makes money by charging a small, flat, transparent platform fee on top of your rate. How to apply: Go here: https://build.a.team/remotivereferral + mention Remotive. We respect your time so the application is short. We're also much more interested in seeing what you've made, and excited to chat more if there’s a fit. What you’ll do: Once part of A.Team, you’ll regularly be invited to impactful missions that match your interests. Find the right pick from early-stage incubations with world-class founders, to fast-growing super-funded companies, to old school non-tech incumbents looking to build as a tech giant would Missions usually involve building an ambitious piece of software from 0 to 1 as part of a small 3-4 person team. You’ll be paid to scope it out, give the client options, guide strategy, and execute on the selected solution. Sometimes the client has a clear vision, sometimes not; which is why A.Team builders tend to be senior folks who can work together to find the right direction. Who A · Team is for: Senior software developers who left large companies and high-growth startups to pursue their craft with autonomy. Those who prefer consistent contract work over a full-time role, who want to create a variety of new products alongside other top-tier builders. The majority of A.Teamers spend most of their time doing independent work, but a sizeable percentage are either employed full-time (but testing out client work), bootstrapping a side project, or looking for their next big thing Who A · Team is not for: People looking for small gigs Folks looking to build simple wordpress/wix/squarespace-style websites Those still early in their careers (<4 years) and recent university/bootcamp grads (at least not yet) Our long-term vision: A·Team is a new type of company for a new kind of independent software builder. We call them "unhirables": people who traditional companies couldn’t hire full-time even if they wanted to, but who want to do their most meaningful work with their favorite people in small, autonomous, distributed expert teams. To help us secure amazing missions, we raised $60 million+ from Insight Partenrs, Tiger Global, NFX, RocNation, along with the former CEO of Upwork, the founders of Fiverr and Lemonade, Apple's Global Head of Recruiting, YC Partner Aaron Harris, Wharton's Adam Grant, and Duke's Dan Ariely.

Our client roster includes Google , Stripe , Figma , Hinge , Black Socialists in America , ACLU , Pratt , Parsons , Mozilla , The Nobel Prize , MIT , Gnosis , Etsy & Gagosian . We’re the software team behind innovative products like The Light Phone & Mill , and we operate a global, decentralized community space collective called Index Space . We think of our garden3d as collective for creative people, prioritizing a happy, talented, and diverse studio culture. We work on projects that bring value to our world, and we balance deep care for the work we do with a genuine curiosity about life outside of our jobs. Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development. We’re building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility. Index Space — Community A network of physical spaces all around the world, Index provides space for the exchange of knowledge and tools. We nurture trust within the creative community through generosity and abundance of ideas and care. garden3d TK — Media At garden3d, we’re in the early stages of building an experimental media company exploring emerging themes related to the evolving landscape of technology, design and culture. A lot of our studios, spaces and people gravitate around New York, so there's some pull to be here, and a good part of this job is noticing what's happening in our world and turning it into content. This role will interface with studio leads, designers, developers, editors, animators, photographers, community managers, event producers and ad platforms across every garden3d vertical. This person owns our channels end to end: the garden3d Substack , our podcast, Instagram, X, and the paid accounts behind them. They collab with our team, and a rotating cast of freelance editors, designers and animators, and they run the calendar that keeps a dozen workstreams shipping on time. They think in PESO terms (paid, earned, shared, owned) with the weight on shared and owned media - paid is a tool they use deliberately, and traditional press is a bonus, but not generally where we focus. The ambition runs past marketing a services business. garden3d TK is our young experimental media company, and this role is its engine: books, screenplays, music, media, activations: a record label for ideas. The ideal candidate looks at a worker-owned collective with four studios, a network of community spaces and an open P&L and sees the best content brief on the internet. Responsibilities & Mandates ‍ Quality never less than 8/10 We aspire for 10/10, celebrate 9/10 and never publish anything that’s not an 8/10 - visually, narratively, and in production quality. This person holds that bar across every post, video, essay and episode on every vertical, and would rather kill a piece than let a 6 out the door. Their feedback makes work better and faster, without micromanaging the people who make it. Social That Stops the Scroll They carry a current, practitioner-level read on how each platform works right now: what arrests someone mid-scroll, how a hook earns the next three seconds, why a format lands on TikTok and dies on LinkedIn. Short-form video is a first-class craft here, not an afterthought. ️ A House of Brands, Each in Its Own Voice Sanctuary Computer doesn't sound like XXIX, and neither sounds like Index. They manage several messaging columns at once, keeping each brand's tone distinct while the umbrella story stays coherent. Case Study Production Every client engagement across our creative agencies should end in a case study worth reading. They own that production line - interviewing the team, shaping the narrative, art-directing the assets - and ship case studies that win each studio its next project. ️ Websites That Put Our Best Foot Forward Our websites are usually the first place a prospective client or hire meets us. Unterstützung des Service-Teams bei der täglichen Organisation und Kommunikation. Erstellung von Werkstattaufträgen und Rechnungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Serviceberater. Vor- und Nachbereitung von Kundenterminen , inkl. Unterlagen, Fahrzeugschlüssel, Leihwagen etc. Koordination und Verwaltung von Mietfahrzeugen am Standort. Kassenführung und Abrechnung. Sicherstellung eines professionellen und aufgeräumten Empfangsbereichs . Das bringst du mit: Du hast eine kaufmännische Ausbildung oder Berufserfahrung im Empfangs-, Service- oder Kundenbereich. Du bist ein Organisationstalent und besitzt ein gutes Gespür für Menschen und Situationen. Ob am Telefon, persönlich oder schriftlich beweist du Kommunikationsstärke und setzt diese gewinnbringend ein.
